Leah Park: RFC follow-up: propose validator (fast sync), scheduler (queue/priority), executor (heavy bench). keep UX fast.
Ravi Singh: why split? cost/scale/SLAs?
Leah Park: yes — different scaling, isolate bench failures.
Tom B.: contract worry: who is source of truth?
Priya N.: canonical manifest in S3, validator writes ref. proto: manifest_version, model_id, artifacts[{path,sha256}], compat_level.
Jules: include bench_seed_ids and vetted_snapshot ref. deterministic benches only.
bench-bot: FYI: last heavy bench blocked queue 12 items.
Ravi Singh: sync validator -> accepted|rejected|accepted_pending_bench?
Leah Park: exactly. runtime should route to vetted_version or safe fallback while pending.
Tom B.: need TTL for pending, auto-disable if bench fails.
Priya N.: migration: shim that translates current intake to new proto, feature-flag rollout.
Ravi Singh: telemetry: intake_id -> bench_job_id mapping in KV, propagate trace header.
Leah Park: test plan: unit validator tests, golden-set integration, perf spike sims, chaos KV tests.
Jules: add manifest lint to strip nondeterministic fields.
Tom B.: ownership: bench infra vs runtime infra? define SLAs.
Priya N.: add heuristics: compat_level drives whether full bench required; sampling for experimental.
Leah Park: action items: Priya proto+lint, Ravi telemetry design, Tom fallback semantics doc, Jules seed vector list. I'll draft phased rollout.
